extension-build.description: Builds the Blender extension archives the project's blender_manifest.toml declares through Blender's blender_ext.py, with no Blender installed, one archive per platform the manifest lists and one for every platform where it lists none; a project holding pyproject.toml builds from a staged copy that bundles its local dependencies as subpackages and its locked registry dependencies as the wheels uv selects per platform at the one Python minor its requires-python pins as ==<major>.<minor>.*, leaving out each package its blender dependency group pins as one Blender bundles

package.description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its tracked source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a .zxp ZXPSignCmd signs with a certificate it creates for the build for a CSXS/manifest.xml

install.description: Installs what the project's build wrote in the run's configuration where its host loads it: each package built for this platform through the host's own installer, or the unpacked build folder for a host loading one

release-publish.description: Publishes each host package the target's dependency targets wrote to its host's store through the store's own upload, where the store's credential variable is set and the store lacks that version, and names the missing variable where it is not; runs through nx release publish

unreal-build.description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, with its Clang static analyzer, unity builds off, and no precompiled headers for a check, or for a .uplugin packages it through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin with strict includes once per engine its hosts name after each package its descriptor maps to a folder installs there, runs the automation tests named after it through UnrealEditor-Cmd in each host and reads their result from the exported report, zips each package and the tracked sources with those installed packages and the engine's EngineVersion after the store checks pass, or copies the package into the Plugins folder of each user project

clean.description: Runs the tool's own clean commands when given, then removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare, keeping any the workspace tracks as source

publish.description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command where the destination's credential is set, and names the missing variable where it is not; runs through nx release publish

attach.description: Uploads the files a project's packaging targets wrote to the GitHub release whose tag nx release gives the version its manifest states, through gh release upload --clobber
